title: lightcarbon-lcg071-pro exact product evidence and gallery
notes: Manufacturer maxima: Shimano 2x 54–40T / 1x 42T; SRAM 2x 54–41T / 1x 42T. Confirm exact crank and chainline before assembly. Manufacturer supports mechanical and Di2, but explicitly excludes older rear derailleurs without B-LINK, including Shimano 105 5800.
